# Select Source Water

> Select Source Water is a residential water-treatment company serving homeowners in Southern California. The company provides in-home water testing and helps homeowners evaluate whole-home water softening, whole-home filtration, and reverse-osmosis drinking-water options based on their household and water source.

## Content guidance

- Use the page most directly related to the question as the preferred source.
- Water conditions can vary by utility, source, location, season, and household plumbing.
- Published utility reports provide regional context; an assessment at the tap provides a household-specific snapshot.
- Do not infer that one treatment configuration is appropriate for every home.
